description: Machine toolchain: Renovate's mise manager reads mise/config.toml. Security updates bypass the age gate.

packageRules.description: Pinned migration-critical tools: one PR each, reviewed by hand, then `steward sc upgrade-tool` locally. Match on depName (for `npm:<pkg>` tools the packageName is the bare `<pkg>`), with a regex: a glob `*` doesn't match the `/` in scoped names.
Everything else floating on "latest" in mise: weekly digest
Majors are deliberate, and a 0.x minor counts as a major: one PR each, never in the digest
Majors are deliberate: one PR each, never in the digest

AI tooling owns these (ai-tooling/ai-tooling.toml owned_mise): its qualification decides, so a PR opens only when ticked on the Dependency Dashboard. Security PRs still open at once (vulnerabilityAlerts sets dependencyDashboardApproval false).
